_comment: Deploy to \NVRAM\intercomConfig.json on the processor. REQUIRED for door video. This was once only a fallback behind the video url the panel reports itself (VOIPVideoURLFeedback) - that member DOES NOT EXIST on these panels, confirmed by dumping the live extender on a TST-1080, so the url configured here is the only way to get a picture. Everything else on the intercom page (answer/reject/hangup/DND/mute) works without this file.
_comment2: sipNumber is the primary match key. It is matched against the USER PART of the panel's incoming caller URI, so 'sip:1001@10.0.0.5' matches sipNumber '1001' - put the bare extension here, not a URI. name is the next match (case-insensitive substring of the incoming display name). With exactly ONE station of the same type configured, it is used for every call regardless of match - which is what most single-door houses actually resolve on, because Rava peer-to-peer calls may carry no usable number at all.
_comment5: Test the video WITHOUT pressing the doorbell: 'intercomvideo <tp>' on the processor console pushes the url below and opens the page; 'intercomvideo <tp> rtsp://...' tests an explicit url, which separates a 2N problem from a program problem. Then watch the console for 'INTERCOM TP-n ch5-video state/errorCode' - that is the decoder telling you why there is no picture.
_comment3: rtspUrl requires the 2N Enhanced Video licence (Services > Streaming > RTSP server). Panels need H.264 - they will NOT decode H.265. 2N/Crestron recommend 640x480 @ 30fps, 2048 kbps.
_comment4: type selects the INTERCOM SCENARIO (page layout): 'sip' = scenario 1, a SIP/Rava station (2N Verso) with full call control via the panel's VOIP extender. 'unifi' = scenario 2, a view-only station (UniFi G6 Entry): RTSP video+audio, no SIP session, so no answer/reject/hangup/mic - just video and Dismiss. Defaults to 'sip' when omitted.

stations._comment: SCENARIO 2 EXAMPLE - not yet wired end to end. The UniFi ring-detection driver is still to be built; this entry documents the intended shape. For UniFi Protect, take the rtsps URL from UniFi Devices > camera > Settings > Advanced and convert it: rtsps://<ip>:7441/<id>?enableSrtp becomes rtsp://<ip>:7447/<id> (drop the ? and everything after). Panels cannot do RTSPS/SRTP. Force H.264 - a TSW will not decode H.265.
